# sakana-mcp — llms.txt

MCP server wrapping Sakana AI Scientist v2 for autonomous scientific research
loops (ideate → execute → status → review, Docker-sandboxed).

- Full tool/endpoint/port reference: `llms-full.txt`
- Human quick start: `README.md`
- First-time setup (keys, Docker, vendor checkout): `docs/ONBOARDING.md`
- Researcher workflow: `docs/researcher/README.md`
- Operations (Docker, safety, runbooks): `docs/operations/README.md`
